proof_body:
by
  intro R L _ _ _ x y z n
  simp only [Module.End.pow_apply]
  have e : ⇑(LieAlgebra.ad R L x) = ⇑(LieDerivation.ad R L x) := by
    ext w
    simp
  rw [e]
  exact LieDerivation.iterate_apply_lie (LieDerivation.ad R L x) n y z
